articles.summary: Catena Biosciences, Inc., a biotechnology company pioneering protein conjugation technologies for novel therapeutic development, today announced the expansion of its leadership team with two new executive appointments. The company has appointed Saurabh Johri as Chief Business Officer and Rick Kendall, Ph.D. as Chief Scientific Officer.
articles.title: Catena Biosciences Expands Executive Leadership Team, Appoints Saurabh Johri as Chief Business Officer and Rick Kendall as Chief Scientific Officer
